title: Tesla Schedules Official Roadster Unveil After Nine Years of Delays
detail: Tesla announced an official Roadster unveil event, ending nearly a decade of repeated delays on the high-performance EV first teased in 2017. The event marks a potential re-entry by Tesla into the flagship sports car segment and a showcase of its latest battery and powertrain technology.

media.caption: Tesla schedules Roadster unveil event after nine years of delays
